title: Msi50
caption:
One number that tells you how the whole market's doing.

The MSI 50 is Meme Street's main index, tracking a basket of fifty companies in a single price you can trade like one stock.

Because it's spread across many companies, one bad day for one stock matters less. What moves it: broad sell-offs, the biggest companies, and economic data.

narration: One number that tells you how the whole market's doing. Meet the MSI 50, Meme Street's main index. It tracks a basket of fifty companies in a single price. Inside are fifty companies, rolled into one price, that you can trade like a single stock. Traders use it to see how the whole market is doing at a glance, and to trade the market's direction. Unlike a single stock, it's spread across many companies, so one bad day for one company matters less. The risks? A broad sell-off hits it hard, the biggest companies move it most, and economic data can swing the whole basket. On Meme Street, big news hits the news wire, and the index reacts. Trade the MSI 50 at memestreet.net.
